ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/gray) pixels concentrated in localized circular markings and mottled patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is high-density black. White mottling is concentrated on the outer distal edge of the left lobe. Discrete high-contrast white circular ring structures are distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep, sharp vertex dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary characterized by high-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) across the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curves extending from the central notch toward the distal tips, terminating in irregular, jagged points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial distribution of white-on-black circular ring-like clusters, varying in diameter, representing localized pigment loss or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, short-length linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-medial section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rings) across both lobes; live barnacle colonies (calcareous white protrusions) are visible attached to the trailing and distal edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Physical protrusion of barnacle clusters breaking the smooth geometric silhouette of the fluke tips.
